gates.pilot_expansion: An individual preregistered arm must pass Omega512 background gate in BOTH AB andBA on at least3 distinct synchronized groups across at least2fit scenes. No union of per-arm valid sets. Report every arm.
gates.expansion_scope: Only if pilot gate passes: remaining42 uniform and30 hard TRAIN pairs already fixed in96cohort; no rerun first24; same matched arms andoldVGGT/traditional controls, max72 newpairs.
gates.identity_admission: Require at least3 jointly AB/BA reliable groups across2fit scenes among NEW42 uniform pairs in one same admitted arm; hard30 remain TRAIN diagnostics. Then probe only synchronous actual legal native candidates and certify unknowns offline.
gates.online_admission: Need reliablegeometry AND actual joint solver/threshold/Bank/final-submit counterfactual evidence with known corrections greater than known harms, involving at least2scene-qualified people and2scenes; compare G0/G1/G2/G3/G4conditional/G5 plusNativePrior; no rank-only admission.
gates.depth: Only after reliableF; confidence remains uncalibrated until independent residual calibration, no automaticdepthgate.
gates.stop: If neither new arm passes pilot gate, close this finite512camera-support experiment as insufficient reliable multiscean support. No96expansion, identity training, onlinefusion orfullvideo.
